title: More ways to work with video, vision, and long context
summary:
New models and reference-to-video options led the day, alongside Prime Agent support, community-model controls, and sturdier fallback routing.

Wan Pro and Wan 3.0 gained reference-to-video inputs, and Wan 3.0 can use an ending frame. The model catalog added Mercury 2.5 Preview, DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision, and Claude Fable 5.1. MiniMax M2.7 was rerouted after its previous provider returned deployment errors; per-user RPM limits were also added for several models.

Play now shows a 24-hour health indicator beside community models, and community model providers can require prompt safety checks that callers cannot disable. Hidden public models gained a 12-hour wait before owners can relist them; monitor recovery guidance and health thresholds were adjusted separately. Play also handles chat responses containing text and linked media, while an app listing that did not use the API was removed.

`polli harness` gained a Prime Agent profile for configuring compatible Pollinations models and the Polli skill. Hosted MCP guidance now covers the Pollinations, FFmpeg, and Exa Search servers and how to connect to them. A routing fix addresses failures in nested prompt-agent MCP calls; the dashboard’s MCP copy and the agents architecture guide were also updated.

highlights.title: References become video
highlights.text: Use reference images or videos with `wan-pro`, and reference images, videos, or audio with `wan-3.0`. Wan 3.0 also accepts a second image as an ending frame. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Mercury 2.5 Preview
highlights.text: Try `inception/mercury-2.5-preview` for text generation with tools, reasoning, and a 260,000-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=inception/mercury-2.5-preview).

highlights.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision
highlights.text: Send text and images to `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` for text output, with reasoning and tool support. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp).

highlights.title: Claude Fable 5.1
highlights.text: Use `anthropic/claude-fable-5.1` with text or images, adaptive reasoning, tools, and a 1M-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=anthropic/claude-fable-5.1).

highlights.title: Community model health in Play
highlights.text: Play’s model selector now shows a 24-hour health indicator for community models. Its tooltip includes request count and success rate, so you can check the signal before choosing a model. [Open Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).

highlights.title: Required community model safety
highlights.text: Community model providers can require prompt checks for privacy, secrets, sexual content, violence, or prompt attacks through the API, dashboard, or CLI. The model catalog exposes those requirements as `required_safety`, and callers cannot disable them with `safe=false`. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Prime Agent harness
highlights.text: Configure Prime Agent with Pollinations models and the Polli skill using `polli harness prime on`; use `status` to inspect the setup or `off` to remove it. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).
